task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Using the left arm, grab the smooth off-white plastic fan and set it on the Orange mat facing the robot.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架使用左臂，抓住光滑的灰白色塑料风扇并将其放置在面向机器人的橙色垫子上。
